primary_rule_preserved: Both complete-replica loop mean reductions at least0.15Angstrom versus matched no-extra-chirality-restraint parent
additional_guardrails: Late-half mean must not be worse in either seed; mean temperatures must differ by at most10K. Framework displacement and final geometry are reported independently. No significance claim with two replicas.
avoidance: Do not use early-window-only gains, a favorable seed alone, or restrained-versus-unrestrained comparisons to claim stabilization.
